Bill.BriefDescription: Providing immunity to community corrections officers and the department of corrections for damages arising from acts or omissions in the supervision of offenders in the community unless the acts or omissions constitute gross negligence.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing immunity to community correctionsofficers and the department of corrections for damages arising fromacts or omissions in the supervision of offenders in the communityunless the acts or omissions constitute gross negligence; and adding anew section to chapter 4.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 4.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of corrections and any community corrections officeremployed by the department of corrections are not civilly liable fordamages arising from acts or omissions in the supervision of offendersin the community, unless the acts or omissions constitute grossnegligence.
